definitions.explanation: The act of replacing one thing with another, or exchanging items. The noun form of the verb 取り換える (to replace, to exchange).

examples.japanese: {電池|でんち}の{取|と}り{換|か}えが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
{商品|しょうひん}の{取|と}り{換|か}えはレシートが{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: A receipt is required for product exchanges.

examples.japanese: フィルターの{取|と}り{換|か}え{時期|じき}を{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please check when the filter is due for replacement.

notes:
The noun form of {取|と}り{換|か}える (to replace, to exchange). Refers to the act of swapping one thing for another, whether replacing a worn-out item or exchanging goods.

ALTERNATE WRITING:
Also written as {取替|とりかえ}え. The kanji {換|か} and {替|か} are largely interchangeable here.

COMPOUNDS:
- {取|と}り{換|か}え{時期|じき}: replacement timing
- {取|と}り{換|か}え{工事|こうじ}: replacement work/construction
- {取|と}り{換|か}え{用|よう}: for replacement

USAGE:
The verb form {取|と}り{換|か}える is more common in everyday speech. The noun form appears often in written instructions, product descriptions, and signs.

RELATED WORDS:
- {交換|こうかん}: exchange (more formal, also used for mutual exchange)
- {入|い}れ{替|か}え: switching out, rotation (e.g., staff rotation)
